name: The move an engine performs on its input

values.gloss: many concrete items lifted to a few wholes, each carrying the meaning that licenses the grouping, so that a decision made once at the top covers the many below (the owner's July 'buckets'; a page's sixteen actions as four approvals)
one whole unfolded into the concrete items it entails (a macro action into its micro actions; a settled distinction into the parts it changes)
rows drawn from texts, anchored where they are found
an instance put into a class that exists, or a new class proposed for it (a person into a school)
a position set against another's on a named axis
events or rows told as one story in the owner's terms
a shape checked against its source: an anchor, a value, a page against its plan
rows and exhibits arranged for a reader

note: A catalogue read by move, not only by kind (kind: primitive · relational · synthesis · extraction · comparison says how an engine is built; operation says what it does to its input). The word is the owner's to change.
